holy__root.title: Heal
holy__root.description: Unlocks Heal (Level 3) (43 mana, 42.75 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__root.extra_description: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health. The first skill of the Holy base.

holy__breathe_again.title: Second Wind
holy__breathe_again.description: Teaches Second Wind, an Epic Fight Passive skill: A fatal hit is cancelled by spending all your mana. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

holy__rapid_chant.title: Rapid Chant
holy__rapid_chant.description: Teaches Rapid Chant, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

holy__fortify.title: Fortify
holy__fortify.description: Unlocks Fortify (Level 3) (72 mana, 171 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__fortify.extra_description: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.

holy__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
holy__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

holy__blessing_of_life.title: Blessing of Life
holy__blessing_of_life.description: Unlocks Blessing of Life (Level 3) (14 mana, 14.25 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__blessing_of_life.extra_description: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.

holy__prayer_barrier.title: Prayer Barrier
holy__prayer_barrier.description: Unlocks Prayer Barrier (Level 1) (86 mana, 128.25 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__prayer_barrier.extra_description: Creates a barrier that grants allies Prayer, increasing spell power.

holy__healing_circle.title: Healing Circle
holy__healing_circle.description: Unlocks Healing Circle (Level 3) (43 mana, 35.62 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__healing_circle.extra_description: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within

holy__wisp.title: Wisp
holy__wisp.description: Unlocks Wisp (Level 3) (14 mana, 4.27 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__wisp.extra_description: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.

holy__cloud_of_regeneration.title: Cloud of Regeneration
holy__cloud_of_regeneration.description: Unlocks Cloud of Regeneration (Level 3) (12 mana, 49.88 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__cloud_of_regeneration.extra_description: Hold to slowly heal friendly creatures within a radius around you.

holy__blessing.title: Blessing
holy__blessing.description: Unlocks Blessing (Level 3) (72 mana, 57 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__blessing.extra_description: Applies Blessing to yourself, granting Holy Spell Power and healing received bonus.

holy__cleanse.title: Cleanse
holy__cleanse.description: Unlocks Cleanse (Level 1) (72 mana, 85.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__cleanse.extra_description: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.

holy__auto_heal.title: Auto Heal
holy__auto_heal.description: Teaches Auto Heal, an Epic Fight Passive skill: While you have mana, it is spent automatically to restore the same share of your health. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

holy__time_sand.title: Sacred Time Sand
holy__time_sand.description: Unlocks Sacred Time Sand (Level 3) (0 mana, 14.25 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__time_sand.extra_description: First cast starts a timer. Cast again to reduce the cooldown of all your spells by the average of the timed duration

holy__reservoir_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

holy__sunbeam.extra_description: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.

holy__mana_shield.title: Mana Shield
holy__mana_shield.description: Teaches Mana Shield, an Epic Fight Guard skill: Damage taken is paid for with mana, in proportion to the hit against your max health. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

holy__greater_heal.title: Greater Heal
holy__greater_heal.description: Unlocks Greater Heal (Level 1) (72 mana, 64.12 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__greater_heal.extra_description: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.

holy__guiding_bolt.title: Guiding Bolt
holy__guiding_bolt.description: Unlocks Guiding Bolt (Level 3) (22 mana, 11.4 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__guiding_bolt.extra_description: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them

holy__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
holy__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

holy__angel_wing.extra_description: Cast to gain wings made of holy energy, acting as an elytra, for a brief period of time.

holy__custodia_caeli.title: Custodia Caeli
holy__custodia_caeli.description: Unlocks Custodia Caeli (Level 1) (108 mana, 171 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__custodia_caeli.extra_description: Marks the ground you are aiming at with a sacred preparation circle, then calls down Custodia Caeli, a rotating sigil that blesses every player inside with a long-lasting defensive buff.

holy__resurrection.title: Resurrection
holy__resurrection.description: Unlocks Resurrection (Level 1) (432 mana, 570 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
holy__resurrection.extra_description: Records Resurrection data for the caster and nearby allies. Consumed to prevent death; Stasis damage or a Stasis effect prevents activation.

holy__planned_guardian_angel.extra_description: Summon an angel (a reskinned vex) that heals you and allies instead of attacking.
